title: Key Word Transformation: Set 2
instructions: For questions 1-6, complete the second sentence so that it has a similar meaning to the first sentence, using the word given. Do not change the word given. You must use between three and six words, including the word given.

items.sentence1: The bridge was closed because of structural damage caused by the flood.
items.sentence2Prefix: The bridge was closed as a
items.explanation: 'As a result of' is a fixed phrase meaning 'because of', introducing the cause of the closure.

items.sentence1: The journalist claimed that the minister had lied to parliament.
items.explanation: 'Accuse someone of doing something' is the fixed pattern; the verb after 'of' takes the -ing form ('lying').

items.sentence1: Continuing to argue about this is pointless, since neither of us will change our mind.
items.sentence2Suffix: about this, since neither of us will change our mind.
items.explanation: 'There is no point in doing something' means it is pointless; 'in' is followed by the gerund ('arguing').

items.sentence1: Heavy traffic meant that she could not arrive on time.
items.explanation: 'Prevent someone from doing something' is the fixed pattern; 'from' is followed by the gerund.

items.sentence1: The research was conducted over a period of five years.
items.explanation: 'Carry out research/an investigation' is a fixed collocation meaning to conduct it, here used in the passive ('was carried out').

items.sentence1: It's unlikely that the team will win the championship this year.
items.explanation: 'Stand little/a good/no chance of doing something' describes the likelihood of an outcome and is followed by the gerund.
